id: \bWe study the effect of seasons here. Deerling and Sawsbuck seem to have a strong effect with it.
en: \bWe study the effect of seasons here. Deerling and Sawsbuck seem to have a strong effect with it.
it: \bQui studiamo l'effetto delle stagioni. Sembra che Deerling e Sawsbuck ne siano molto influenzati.

id: \bDo you have a Deerling? I would give you a reward for showing me one.
en: \bDo you have a Deerling? I would give you a reward for showing me one.
it: \bHai un Deerling? Ti darei una ricompensa se me ne mostrassi uno.

id: \bOh you have one. Thank you for showing me!
en: \bOh you have one. Thank you for showing me!
it: \bOh, ne hai uno. Grazie per avermelo mostrato!

id: \bIf you ever find one come back and show me.
en: \bIf you ever find one come back and show me.
it: \bSe mai ne trovi uno, torna a mostrarmelo.

id: \bSawsbuck change as well. I wonder why.
en: \bSawsbuck change as well. I wonder why.

id: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \bSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \bOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!
